name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted SEO intelligence over Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, PageSpeed, CrUX, Cloudflare, IndexNow, and optional local Lighthouse: persistent monitoring, internal-link and content opportunities, ownership, remediation, onboarding, and multi-provider backlinks. Writable by default with one read-only switch. MCP over Streamable HTTP at /mcp, plus REST.

url.title: Rankrat URL
url.description: Base URL of your running Rankrat server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (MCP is served at /mcp).

token.title: HTTP bearer
token.description: Contents of the server profile's secrets/rankrat/http-bearer-token.
